svg.desc: Индикатор утечки радиации по показаниям ANA сигналов

rt:var.name: Color_for_OK
rt:var.comment: Цвет для хороших показаний (нет утечки радиации)

rt:model.rt:sub: Sub Detect_Leackage() Dim Worst_Quality As UByte Dim MyAlarm As Boolean Worst_Quality = PLS_QUALSUB_GOOD Bound_Violation_max = -1 In_Alarm = 0 MyAlarm = true If pv1 != Nothing Then If pv1.BoundViolType == PLS_BOUNDVIOL_HI Then Bound_Violation_max = pv1.BoundViolIndex End If If pv1.QualitySubstatus == PLS_QUALSUB_LOCALOVERRIDE Then Worst_Quality = PLS_QUALSUB_LOCALOVERRIDE ElseIf pv1.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD Then Worst_Quality = PLS_QUALSUB_BAD End If If Blink_on_NACK && Alarms_ForUser Then //проверяем только если надо мигать и сигнализации для пользователей MyAlarm = PRJSPEC.Grant_for_CSGAD_Mask(pv1.PVNr, true, 5) //true = ANA; 5 = отобр. и квитир. сигнализаций End If If Blink_on_NACK && MyAlarm && pv1.NotAcknowledged Then //проверяем только если надо мигать, наша сигнализация и она не квитированная If pv1.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm = 1 //снятая неквитированная сигнализация Else In_Alarm = 3 //нормальная неквитированная сигнализация End If End If End If If pv2 != Nothing Then If pv2.BoundViolType == PLS_BOUNDVIOL_HI Then If Bound_Violation_max < pv2.BoundViolIndex Then Bound_Violation_max = pv2.BoundViolIndex End If End If If Worst_Quality != PLS_QUALSUB_BAD Then If pv2.QualitySubstatus == PLS_QUALSUB_LOCALOVERRIDE Then Worst_Quality = PLS_QUALSUB_LOCALOVERRIDE ElseIf pv2.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD Then Worst_Quality = PLS_QUALSUB_BAD End If End If If Blink_on_NACK && (In_Alarm != 3) Then //проверяем только если надо мигать и сигнализации нет If Alarms_ForUser Then MyAlarm = PRJSPEC.Grant_for_CSGAD_Mask(pv2.PVNr, true, 5) End If If MyAlarm && pv2.NotAcknowledged Then If pv2.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 1 Else In_Alarm = 3 End If End If End If End If If pv3 != Nothing Then If pv3.BoundViolType == PLS_BOUNDVIOL_HI Then If Bound_Violation_max < pv3.BoundViolIndex Then Bound_Violation_max = pv3.BoundViolIndex End If End If If Worst_Quality != PLS_QUALSUB_BAD Then If pv3.QualitySubstatus == PLS_QUALSUB_LOCALOVERRIDE Then Worst_Quality = PLS_QUALSUB_LOCALOVERRIDE ElseIf pv3.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD Then Worst_Quality = PLS_QUALSUB_BAD End If End If If Blink_on_NACK && (In_Alarm != 3) Then If Alarms_ForUser Then MyAlarm = PRJSPEC.Grant_for_CSGAD_Mask(pv3.PVNr, true, 5) End If If MyAlarm && pv3.NotAcknowledged Then If pv3.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 1 Else In_Alarm = 3 End If End If End If End If If pv4 != Nothing Then If pv4.BoundViolType == PLS_BOUNDVIOL_HI Then If Bound_Violation_max < pv4.BoundViolIndex Then Bound_Violation_max = pv4.BoundViolIndex End If End If If Worst_Quality != PLS_QUALSUB_BAD Then If pv4.QualitySubstatus == PLS_QUALSUB_LOCALOVERRIDE Then Worst_Quality = PLS_QUALSUB_LOCALOVERRIDE ElseIf pv4.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD Then Worst_Quality = PLS_QUALSUB_BAD End If End If If Blink_on_NACK && (In_Alarm != 3) Then If Alarms_ForUser Then MyAlarm = PRJSPEC.Grant_for_CSGAD_Mask(pv4.PVNr, true, 5) End If If MyAlarm && pv4.NotAcknowledged Then If pv4.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 1 Else In_Alarm = 3 End If End If End If End If If Bound_Violation_max == -1 Then BodyColor = Color_for_OK ElseIf Bound_Violation_max == 0 Then BodyColor = Color_ANA_HI_T ElseIf Bound_Violation_max == 1 Then BodyColor = Color_ANA_HI_P ElseIf Bound_Violation_max >= 2 Then BodyColor = Color_ANA_HI_A End If If Worst_Quality == PLS_QUALSUB_BAD Then AuxColor = Color_Inval ElseIf Worst_Quality == PLS_QUALSUB_LOCALOVERRIDE Then AuxColor = Color_Imitation Else AuxColor = 0 //black End If End Sub
rt:model.rt:event: If PointID_1 != "NULL" Then pv1 = ANA(PointID_1) End If If PointID_2 != "NULL" Then pv2 = ANA(PointID_2) End If If PointID_3 != "NULL" Then pv3 = ANA(PointID_3) End If If PointID_4 != "NULL" Then pv4 = ANA(PointID_4) End If Color_for_OK = Middle_Color_Wieghted(Color_ANA_GOOD, Color_ALTERNATIVE, Degree_of_main_color) If (pv1 == Nothing) && (pv2 == Nothing) && (pv3 == Nothing) && (pv1 == Nothing) Then BodyColor = Color_ANA_ER_LINK Else BodyColor = Color_for_OK End If

rect.rt:event: Dim ParStr As String Dim MainId As String MainId = "" If pv1 != Nothing Then ParStr = pv1.PVId + "|" MainId = pv1.PVId Else ParStr = "|" End If If pv2 != Nothing Then ParStr = ParStr + pv2.PVId + "|" If MainId == "" Then MainId = pv2.PVId End If Else ParStr = ParStr + "|" End If If pv3 != Nothing Then ParStr = ParStr + pv3.PVId + "|" If MainId == "" Then MainId = pv3.PVId End If Else ParStr = ParStr + "|" End If If pv4 != Nothing Then ParStr = ParStr + pv4.PVId If MainId == "" Then MainId = pv4.PVId End If End If If ParStr == "|||" Then ShowWarning("Объект не[правильно] привязан.",10) Else Open_Win_Uni(False, MainId, PRJSPEC.RTM (MainId, False), "wi_ana_rad_leackage", MainId + "|" + ParStr) // Call_Win ("wi_ana_rad_leackage", MainId + "|" + ParStr) End If
